dataset_name: Pickleball Cosmos U.S. Court Infrastructure Database — 2026 Baseline
geographic_scope: 50 U.S. states; District of Columbia and U.S. territories excluded from rankings

license.name: Pickleball Cosmos Dataset Use Terms
license.scope_note: The use terms govern Pickleball Cosmos-created calculations, normalization, metadata and analysis while preserving third-party rights in underlying source inputs. No blanket open-data license is asserted for third-party directory data.

sources.name: U.S. Census Bureau — Vintage 2025 National and State Population Estimates

normalization.rule: Use only canonical full-name rows for the 50 U.S. states.
normalization.reason: Abbreviated rows could not be established as unique rather than duplicate classifications; D.C., territories and aggregate rows are outside the 50-state ranking scope.

fields.name: population
fields.description: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2025 resident population estimate for July 1, 2025

fields.name: locations
fields.description: Listed pickleball locations in the dated Pickleheads state-directory snapshot

fields.name: courts
fields.description: Listed pickleball courts in the dated Pickleheads state-directory snapshot

fields.name: courts_per_100k
fields.description: Pickleball Cosmos calculation: courts per 100,000 residents

fields.name: locations_per_100k
fields.description: Pickleball Cosmos calculation: locations per 100,000 residents

fields.name: courts_per_location
fields.description: Pickleball Cosmos calculation: listed courts divided by listed locations

fields.name: vs_us_avg_pct
fields.description: Percent difference from the 50-state aggregate courts-per-100,000 rate

Underlying third-party source inputs remain subject to the rights and terms of their respective publishers. No open-data license is asserted for the Pickleheads directory inputs.
citation: Pickleball Cosmos Editorial. Pickleball Cosmos U.S. Court Infrastructure Database — 2026 Baseline, version 2026.1. Pickleball Cosmos, August 12, 2026.
